title: Twincity Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Twincity Marathon 2027 Review | Putrajaya and Cyberjaya
meta_description: Twincity Marathon review: 21,200+ runners for the 11th edition in January 2026, a new start at Dataran Putrajaya and a new route across both cities.
dek: The Twincity Marathon drew more than 21,200 runners across Putrajaya and Cyberjaya in January 2026, with a new start and a new route. Here is what the 11th edition was like.
verdict: The Twincity Marathon is a big January race run across the twin cities of Putrajaya and Cyberjaya. The 11th edition, over 17 and 18 January 2026, drew more than 21,200 runners, including international athletes from Japan, Indonesia and Vietnam [1]. The start moved from Cyberjaya to Dataran Putrajaya to cope with the growing field, and the route was completely new while still crossing both cities [1]. About 3,500 ran the full marathon [1]. Finishers were served freshly cooked fried bihun [1]. If you want a big, festive marathon near Kuala Lumpur with a route that covers two planned cities, it is a strong choice.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: More than 21,200 runners took part over the weekend of 17 and 18 January 2026 [1]. The full marathon had about 3,500 participants, and the largest category drew about 10,600 [1].
The start moved from Cyberjaya to Dataran Putrajaya, which the organiser, Ten Senses, said gave more parking and room for a race village for around 20,000 participants [1].

sections.heading: A New Route Across Two Cities
paragraphs: The 2026 route was completely new, but kept the race's signature of running across both Putrajaya and Cyberjaya [1]. There was cheering, music and cultural performances along the way, and local food stalls at the race village [1].
A race tradition continued at the finish: freshly cooked fried bihun for runners [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Muhamad Haziq Hamzah won the men's open marathon in 2:41:41 and Noor Amelia Musa the women's in 3:13:05 [1]. Japan's Kazuya Sato won the men's international category in 2:50:36 and Vietnam's Vu Khanh Linh the women's in 3:09:28 [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large, well-attended marathon near Kuala Lumpur. The move to Dataran Putrajaya was made to handle the growing crowd, and the route across two cities is distinctive.
Pace for a warm morning, and check the 2027 start times when they are published.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.answer: More than 21,200 runners took part in the 11th edition over 17 and 18 January 2026, including about 3,500 in the full marathon, with international runners from Japan, Indonesia and Vietnam.

faqs.question: Where does the Twincity Marathon start?
faqs.answer: Since 2026, at Dataran Putrajaya. It previously started in Cyberjaya and was moved to make room for the growing field and race village. The route still crosses both Putrajaya and Cyberjaya.

faqs.answer: Muhamad Haziq Hamzah won the men's open marathon in 2:41:41 and Noor Amelia Musa the women's in 3:13:05. Japan's Kazuya Sato and Vietnam's Vu Khanh Linh won the international categories.
